release_route: presidio-extras/v0.1.1 -> GitHub Actions trusted publishing -> PyPI
scope: Packaging-only patch release. Closes the three minors deferred by the 0.1.0 gate (bundled Apache-2.0 LICENSE, package-local .gitignore, pinned build backend). No product code, test, or claim change.
delta: PR #366: package-local LICENSE (sha256 cfc7749b...523d30, identical to the repo root) and .gitignore added to packages/sdk and packages/presidio-extras; [build-system] requires pinned to hatchling==1.32.4 for both published packages.
PR #367: packages/presidio-extras version 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1 and uv.lock follow-up.

git diff bc072cc..1f7a10d -- packages/presidio-extras/src packages/presidio-extras/tests packages/presidio-extras/scripts packages/presidio-extras/README.md => empty (product code, tests, and claims byte-identical to the approved 0.1.0).

validation.build: wheel and sdist byte-reproducible across two builds; wheel Generator: hatchling 1.32.4
validation.license: wheel .dist-info/licenses/LICENSE (11358 B) and sdist LICENSE both sha256 cfc7749b...523d30 == repo root; METADATA has License: Apache-2.0 and License-File: LICENSE
validation.sdist_gitignore: package-local 4-line .gitignore; the 101-line repo-root .gitignore no longer leaks

findings.claim: No before/after baseline, eval logic, or threshold change in this delta.
findings.evidence: `git diff bc072cc..1f7a10d --stat` => LICENSE/.gitignore/pyproject.toml/uv.lock/gate json only; `git diff bc072cc..1f7a10d -- packages/presidio-extras/src packages/sdk/src` => empty; blob hashes for jev.py, eval_jev_context.py, test_jev_context.py identical; min_confidence 0.9 and the (0.5,1] check unchanged.
findings.conclusion: N/A. Packaging/version only; no baseline validity to assess.

findings.claim: No F1/P/R, CI, or significance claim is added.
findings.evidence: `git diff bc072cc..1f7a10d --name-status` => packaging + the 0.1.0 gate record; extras README still states 'not a NER precision/recall benchmark'.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No new metric claim; 0.1.1 is a version string.

findings.claim: No per-label recall floor breach or latency regression; no concealed regression.
findings.evidence: Product code byte-identical (blob hashes above); `pytest packages/presidio-extras/tests -q` => 43 passed, `packages/sdk/tests -q` => 63 passed; thresholds and evaluator unchanged.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No overall metric exists, so no label-level regression can be masked; test counts and thresholds match the 0.1.0 verdict.

findings.claim: The 0.1.1 version/tag claim is consistent with the artifact.
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:3 version 0.1.1; uv.lock 0.1.0 -> 0.1.1; release-presidio-extras.yml:66-74 verifies tag vs pyproject; `git tag -l 'presidio-extras/*'` => v0.1.0 only (v0.1.1 not yet cut).
findings.conclusion: No problem. tag/version align and no metric needs a source citation.

findings.claim: The hatchling==1.32.4 pin is resolvable and does not affect the metrics.
findings.evidence: hatchling 1.32.4 is the latest on pypi.org; with the default local index the pin fails only because ~/.config/uv/uv.toml sets exclude-newer='1 days' and the mirror lags (pypi.flatt.tech has up to 1.32.3); `UV_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.org/simple uv build` succeeds and bundles LICENSE. CI uses pypi.org with no exclude-newer.
findings.conclusion: No statistical impact. The pin resolves on the release CI path; the local failure is an environment (mirror + exclude-newer) artifact.

findings.claim: The 0.1.0 minor 'Apache-2.0 LICENSE text absent from wheel/sdist' is resolved.
findings.evidence: wheel => pleno_presidio_extras-0.1.1.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE (11358 B); sdist => pleno_presidio_extras-0.1.1/LICENSE; METADATA => License: Apache-2.0, License-File: LICENSE.
findings.conclusion: Resolved. The 0.1.0 finding no longer reproduces.

findings.claim: The bundled LICENSE is the unmodified Apache-2.0 with no added terms.
findings.evidence: sha256 of repo-root LICENSE, packages/presidio-extras/LICENSE, packages/sdk/LICENSE, and both artifacts' LICENSE all cfc7749b...523d30; no NOTICE file, so Apache-2.0 section 4(d) is not triggered.
findings.conclusion: Identical to root, unmodified, no extra terms.

findings.claim: The 0.1.0 minor 'repo-root .gitignore leaks internal paths into the sdist' is resolved.
findings.evidence: sdist .gitignore == the package-local 4-line file; the 101-line repo-root .gitignore (packages/training paths, .env.keys, etc.) is absent from `tar tzf`.
findings.conclusion: Resolved. Only the inert package-local ignore file ships.

findings.claim: No training/eval data or model contamination; the eval-only ai4privacy/pii-masking-300k constraint is untouched.
findings.evidence: `git diff --name-status bc072cc..1f7a10d` => packaging + gate json only; `git diff bc072cc..HEAD -- packages/models packages/training` => empty; no dataset references in the package; no leaked secrets or internal paths in the unpacked sdist.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No dataset, model, or training change; the license-encumbered dataset is neither trained on nor shipped.

findings.claim: No new accuracy/F1/benchmark claim; the synthetic smoke is not relabelled as a metric.
findings.evidence: `git diff --stat presidio-extras/v0.1.0..HEAD -- packages/presidio-extras/README.md src tests scripts` => empty; the script still self-labels 'not a NER accuracy benchmark'.
findings.conclusion: No exaggeration added; the documented surface is unchanged from the approved 0.1.0.

findings.claim: The pinned hatchling==1.32.4 is not resolvable from the environment's configured mirror, so the pin is the one un-exercised part of the delta.
findings.evidence: default index => 'No solution found when resolving: hatchling==1.32.4'; pypi.flatt.tech has up to 1.32.3; pypi.org has 1.32.4; `UV_INDEX_URL=https://pypi.org/simple uv build` succeeds; the release workflow uses setup-uv with no UV_INDEX_URL (pypi.org).
findings.conclusion: Not a contamination issue and not a blocker on the pypi.org release path (reproduced the exact build command). The pin had not been built by CI yet because ci.yml only runs uv sync/ruff/pytest; a workflow_dispatch dry-run is recommended before the tag.

findings.claim: pyproject version 0.1.1 matches the tag presidio-extras/v0.1.1 and the workflow fails closed on mismatch.
findings.evidence: pyproject.toml:3 version 0.1.1; release-presidio-extras.yml:18 and :61-76 compare tag to pyproject; simulated REF_NAME=presidio-extras/v0.1.1 => MATCH; only v0.1.0 exists so far.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Version/tag alignment is validated mechanically before publish.

findings.claim: uv.lock follows the 0.1.1 bump.
findings.evidence: uv.lock:2806-2808 version 0.1.1; `env -u UV_INDEX_URL uv lock --check --no-config` exit 0.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Lock matches pyproject.

findings.claim: Wheel and sdist are byte-reproducible and the hatchling pin is applied.
findings.evidence: two builds => identical wheel/sdist sha256; wheel WHEEL metadata reports 'Generator: hatchling 1.32.4'; pyproject.toml requires hatchling==1.32.4.
findings.conclusion: No problem. The previously-deferred unpinned-hatchling item is resolved and observable in the artifact metadata.

findings.claim: The build-system comment 'reproducible over time' is necessary but not fully sufficient because transitive build deps stay unpinned.
findings.evidence: hatchling is pinned but its runtime deps (packaging, pluggy, pathspec, trove-classifiers, editables) are not; uv.lock does not cover build isolation; two same-day rebuilds are byte-identical.
findings.conclusion: Minor wording overreach, not a defect; the realistic drift lever (hatchling's version string embedded in WHEEL) is pinned and verified. Does not block.

findings.claim: LICENSE is bundled in both artifacts and the root .gitignore leak is gone.
findings.evidence: wheel .dist-info/licenses/LICENSE + METADATA License-File; sdist LICENSE sha256 == repo root; sdist .gitignore is the 4-line package-local file.
findings.conclusion: No problem. Both 0.1.0 packaging deferrals are fixed.

findings.claim: Test and lint gates are green with counts unchanged from 0.1.0.
findings.evidence: `pytest packages/presidio-extras/tests -q` => 43 passed; ruff check/format pass (same commands as ci.yml:64-70).
findings.conclusion: No problem. Same 43 tests as the approved 0.1.0 verdict.

findings.claim: Disposition of the 0.1.0 deferrals.
findings.evidence: license not bundled -> resolved; root .gitignore in sdist -> resolved; hatchling unpinned -> resolved; product code/tests/README unchanged (`git diff --stat bc072cc..1f7a10d -- ...` empty).
findings.conclusion: No problem. All three prior deferrals are closed; the delta is packaging-only.

findings.claim: PR #366 also pins packages/sdk build-system and adds its LICENSE/.gitignore inside the extras-release commit.
findings.evidence: `git diff bc072cc..1f7a10d -- packages/sdk/pyproject.toml` => hatchling pin; packages/sdk/{LICENSE,.gitignore} added. No sdk tag is cut in this release.
findings.conclusion: No problem for this release: the extras artifact is unaffected and the SDK change is a strict improvement; noted only because it rides an extras commit.

findings.claim: No model/NER metric or training claim in scope.
findings.evidence: delta touches only packaging/version/gate json; no packages/models or packages/training code change.
findings.conclusion: N/A. No statistical claim exists to reproduce.

deferred: Transitive build dependencies of hatchling remain unpinned (uv.lock does not cover build isolation); the comment wording is slightly broader than that guarantees.
